title: Cancer
body:

Candice-Marie Fox, 31, a former modelwho was given just five years to live with an
aggressive cancer, turned down chemo and claims she has beaten the disease - by eating
pineapples as well as dozens of grapefruits, lemons, apples, kiwis and bananas.
Mark Simon, director at the Nutritional Oncology Research Institute in California, has helped
Candice, and has seen her test results.
Mark Simon is an engineer that I worked with who’s wife died over 10 years ago of breast
cancer. He has accumulated much research before and since her death.
One huge finding is that cancer needs protein to survive. Protein is composed of amino acids
four of which are essential for cancer survival but are not essential for human survival.
Methionine is essential for cancer survival but not that essential for human survival and is
easiest to eliminate from the diet. He has also developed a substance to neutralize
methionine.
